positions.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
positions.thesisSummary: Debt-free, vertically integrated generics maker (US/UK/Australia OTC + Rx) with in-house CMO capacity; ROCE ~22.5%, PAT +64% YoY in Q4 FY26, and a confirmed uptrend (golden cross). USFDA approvals keep widening the product basket.
positions.invalidation: Adverse USFDA action (warning letter/import alert); OPM contraction >300bps for two consecutive quarters; debt-funded M&A pushing D/E above 0.5; or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.
positions.lastNote: As of 11 Jun 2026: Rs 257.25 (+2.9% on the session) on a block deal. USFDA final approval for Benzonatate ANDA confirmed — positive and in-thesis. Above 50-DMA (206) & 200-DMA (235); golden cross intact. Watch: identity of the block-deal counterparties. (Web aggregators, 11 Jun 2026.)
